summary: ShipShipShip is a self-hosted platform designed to manage changelogs and roadmaps by connecting internal project tasks with customer-facing updates. It functions as a central hub to publish release notes and track product development milestones.
goodFor: Teams looking to streamline their release communication and connect project progress directly to public-facing updates using an Apache-2.0 licensed tool.
watchOut: The project currently shows signs of lower maintenance activity relative to its age, meaning you may need to patch bugs yourself or rely on a small community for support.
deployNotes: As it is packaged via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
